text:
marisol: Hi team — accepted the org invite but I only see the public repos. Trying to get into infra/private-templates and it says "request access". I also got a prompt to enable 2FA and an SSO button that errors. Any tips?

onboarding-bot: Welcome @marisol :wave: Quick checklist: (1) Make sure you accepted the invite with the same GitHub account you plan to use. (2) Enable 2FA (required). (3) If your account uses SSO, accept the SSO authorization after joining the org. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/github

marisol: I accepted with my work account but I also signed in with my personal one earlier this morning. How can I check which account GH is using for the invitation?

sam: If you go to github.com/settings/organizations it shows your membership status per org. If you see "Pending" next to Redwood Inference, click the SSO/Authorize button. Also double-check the email on the GitHub account matches the one in the invite.

marisol: emails are messy — I used marisol.work@example.com for the invite but my account shows marisol@gmail as primary. Can I add the work email to my existing account?

devx-bot: You can add an email to your GitHub account under Settings -> Emails. After adding, verify it. If you prefer not to merge emails, you can also create a new account with your work email and accept the invite with that.

tiffany: @marisol I can try re-sending a team invite if SSO mapping isn't picking up. Which GitHub username did you accept with (no @ please)?

marisol: username is marisol-ml. I just added my work email and verified it, but when I click "Authorize SSO" I get a 403: "Access blocked".

sam: 403 on SSO usually means your GitHub account needs to be added to the org via our identity provider mapping. Two quick things: (1) try signing out of github.com and sign back in with marisol-ml, then accept the org invite link directly: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation (2) if that fails, @tiffany can add you to eng-core manually which should grant repo access while we debug SSO.

marisol: signed out/in and used the invite link — still blocked.

tiffany: doing the manual team add now. Adding marisol-ml to eng-core and eng-onboarding.

marisol: got a GitHub notification for team invite, accepted. I can now open infra/private-templates but can't push. Says "You do not have write access". Is that expected?

sam: New hires typically get read + issue access initially. Engineering onboarding policy grants write access after the first-week checklist is completed and after you accept the CLA in the repo. Check the repo README for CONTRIBUTING and the CLA link. If you need a quick perms bump for pair programming, we can give temporary write access — @tiffany can confirm.

tiffany: I can grant push access to the repo for a week. Do you need it now for a pairing session?

marisol: Yes please — pairing at 2pm PT would be great.

tiffany: granted push access to infra/private-templates for marisol-ml, expires in 7 days. You should be able to push now; if not, try an incognito window to avoid stale sessions.

marisol: push works now, and SSO/2FA stuff looks resolved after the team add. Thanks everyone :tada:

devx-bot: Resolved: manual team addition fixed permissions and SSO mapping. If you hit more issues file a new thread in #help or ping @tiffany for fast perms changes.
